text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I thought I heard someone call me... 
Must've just imagined it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though—them Three Goddesses sure are 
purty. Reckon they were "city girls" after 
all?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Goddess, if I work hard, do you think 
I can become a proper 'City Girl' 
someday?"
